comparison_policy: Cross target-relative block phase 0/15 with plot-relative tick phase 0/15. Exact B1/B2 prompts and frozen strict parsers; do not adopt simplified C1 contract. Layout once at original ticks, only ticks and associated vertical grids vary
candidate_policy: All 17 original targets from the same 72 cached windows, complete six-record scoring including no-target stationary record. Same global raw PNG, local curve, limits, dimensions and context; no numeric summaries or derivative images
schedule: Two complete sorted passes. Four-arm cyclic order rotated by target ordinal plus twice repetition. No selected reruns, repair, clipping or success-only official results
stage_policy: Identical saved XGBoost head, features, support and missing masks. No fitting or threshold change
development_check: Each alternative vs concurrent p0_t0 in each repeat: retain all 81 weak days, no increase in failures, FP days or false-A days, no decrease in activity F1 or stage macro-F1. Both repeats must pass, report every arm irrespective of outcome; no best-phase adoption from this searched development set
report_policy: All 136 calls, complete records, each repeat separately; conditional factor differences and difference of differences, repeat disagreement, errors, unknown-reference confirmations, target answers, failures and cost. Alignment contrast is descriptive mean of aggregate metrics, not pooled independent data
limits: Six previously viewed synthetic development records with correlated AI-assisted labels previously exposed to generator truth; only one 81-day weak episode and two repeats. Tick intervention also changes vertical grids; not model-internal attention causation. Strict contract failures contribute to scores. Offline centered stage features include future data. No independent, field or online superiority claim
